title: Inspect and validate structured data
summary: Read bounded local JSON, JSONL, CSV, TSV, YAML, or Parquet data to describe its shape or evaluate explicit deterministic constraints without rewriting it.

operations.title: Inspect structured data
operations.description: Return source format and byte count, bounded record-set and field profiles, and a small deterministic sample. This operation describes records inside a data source; it does not identify the broader file envelope or transform the data.

errors.description: The source or option shape is outside the portable contract.
The named local source does not exist.
The source path escapes or violates the explicit workspace grant.
The source format is not supported or cannot be determined.
The source does not satisfy the declared structured-data syntax.
The read, parse, shape, sample, or response exceeded a declared bound.
The provider could not safely complete the operation.

operations.title: Validate structured data
operations.description: Evaluate an explicit JSON Schema, deterministic assertions, or both against a bounded local structured-data source. Constraint failures are successful validation results with valid=false; malformed constraints are errors.

errors.description: The source or option shape is outside the portable contract.
No constraint was supplied or a JSON Schema or assertion is malformed.
The named local source does not exist.
The source path escapes or violates the explicit workspace grant.
The source format is not supported or cannot be determined.
The source does not satisfy the declared structured-data syntax.
The read, validation, sample, or response exceeded a declared bound.
The provider could not safely complete the operation.
